remarks: Wonderful opportunity to live in Stamford! Come check out Mill River House located across from Mill River Park. Enjoy all the events and activities at Mill River Park. Enjoy the Carousel, the ice-skating rink or just walk and enjoy the beauty of Stamford downtown. The condo is walking distance to UCONN, Stamford, to theaters, restaurants, shopping and a short drive/walk to Stamford Train Station. It has 2 bedrooms and 2 full baths, a living/dining area and an open kitchen with an island. PLUS a charming patio/deck that faces the courtyard where you can enjoy being outside. You also have your very own laundry room in the unit. The building has underground parking, an elevator, a private gym, club-house, a concierge and outdoor patio along with a grilling and picnic area. Come make this very special unit your own. It will go fast!
